setup.command: if ! command -v flutter >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ ! -x "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" ]; then curl -fsSL -o /tmp/flutter.tar.xz https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.35.4-stable.tar.xz && tar -C "$HOME" -xzf /tmp/flutter.tar.xz && rm -f /tmp/flutter.tar.xz && ln -sf "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" /usr/local/bin/flutter && ln -sf "$HOME/flutter/bin/dart" /usr/local/bin/dart; fi
